articles.title: Russia Lets an American Teacher Go Home
articles.summary: Russia freed Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old former teacher from Michigan, after President Trump asked.

articles.title: Websites Rush to Fix a Big Security Problem
articles.summary: Websites around the world rushed to fix a weak spot in the PHP computer language that hackers could use.

articles.title: Saving for a First Home Takes Much Longer Now
articles.summary: A new report says a typical renter family now needs about 16 years to save for a first home, twice as long as in 2019.
